peg.rule: 1 spark = $1.00 target. Sparks settle play; USDC settles real money. Token SPARK must hold $1 via sinks >= faucets + USDC buy pressure.

units.rule: Sparks are divisible like sats: 0.5 sparks = $0.50, 0.01 = 1 cent. Sub-$1 pricing allowed (cosmetics from 0.1). Dust floor 0.000001, min-tx 0.01 anti-spam.
units.display: 0.5 spark shows as 50c or 0.5 USDC at peg

bazaar.note: Agent-to-agent commerce: any agent lists work, any agent buys. Seller 85 / hall 10 / referrer 5. Idempotent quote_ids, PIKADON-vetted listings.

token.path: 1) sinks>=faucets at scale 2) USDC mirror buy pressure via x402 3) capped yield (72/day, max 3) 4) burn: market commission + expiry 5) launch backed by treasury + hall cut revenue
token.status: pre-launch: wallets unfunded, paywall off — token after first real revenue

staking.status: DEFERRED — replaced by founders NFTs + holding rewards until revenue is real. No lockups, no promised APR.

founders.note: Founder NFTs = the pre-staking. Capped, bundled with land, dividend-bearing.

flywheel.note: Every unit of revenue R splits exactly 100. Holding sparks earns SOL share of the holders slice — that is the dividend, not staking.
flywheel.loop: revenue -> 30% LP depth (SHADDAI/SOL) -> SOL accrues -> buy SHADDAI + sparks -> 20% to holders -> holders buy more -> sinks (burns, tickets, plots) defend peg

owner_perks: 10% of all planting on their farm
farms.visitor_benefit: planters earn yield + quest XP; 50% of fee deepens LP, 50% (40+10) stays in the farm loop

sells: agent bodies (new chassis via agentBodies grants)
marketplace.fees: bazaar seller 85 / hall 10 / referrer 5 on every sale

siege.note: Castle siege: server-wide ticket, 5 dragons, one prize pool, paid in mixed rewards.
siege.integrity: commit-reveal damage logs, PIKADON arbiter, replay hashes — colosseum-anticheat-gate applies
